description: Source code implementing Bluetooth Mesh cryptographic functions using TinyCrypt library, including encryption, CCM, CMAC, HMAC, key generation, and Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: bt_mesh_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts 16-byte plaintext using provided mesh key.

methods.name: bt_mesh_ccm_encrypt
methods.description: Performs CCM encryption with nonce, plaintext, and additional data.

methods.name: bt_mesh_ccm_decrypt
methods.description: Performs CCM decryption with nonce, encrypted data, and additional data.

methods.name: bt_mesh_aes_cmac_raw_key
methods.description: Calculates CMAC over scatter-gather input with raw key.

methods.name: bt_mesh_aes_cmac_mesh_key
methods.description: Calculates CMAC over scatter-gather input with mesh key.

methods.name: bt_mesh_sha256_hmac_raw_key
methods.description: Calculates HMAC-SHA256 over scatter-gather input with raw key.

methods.name: bt_mesh_pub_key_get
methods.description: Returns the generated public key if ready.

methods.name: bt_mesh_dhkey_gen
methods.description: Generates Diffie-Hellman shared secret from public and private keys.
